six_player_gate: Both unchanged numerical gates must pass for the same method before new six-player learning.
limitations: Existing 512-step controls are reused with exact checkpoint/model hashes.
Stratum scaling is constant across a fit's replay iterations; no row centering or per-row scaling.
Uniform feature mass changes the finite-network projection objective.
Fitting noisy finite targets is not evidence of poker strength.
Only the initial six-player UTG decision uses the opening expert; no hand/action overrides.
The frozen main expert is the predeclared 32768-step stratum-normalized refit; it is identical before and after the opening expert is added.
Deployment selects one 256-wide neural expert per decision; no live search.
